preconditions.description: The number of actions n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(name) >= 1 and len(name) <= 10 for name in names)
preconditions.description: All names must consist of at least 1 and at most 10 lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(name != your_name for name in names)
preconditions.description: None of the names in the actions can be your name.

postconditions.description: The output must contain all distinct names from the input, excluding your name.

postconditions.expression: all(output_names[i] <= output_names[i + 1] for i in range(len(output_names) - 1) if priority_factors[output_names[i]] == priority_factors[output_names[i + 1]])
postconditions.description: Names with the same priority factor must be sorted lexicographically.

postconditions.expression: all(output_names[i] in names for i in range(len(output_names)))
postconditions.description: All output names must be present in the input actions.
